subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 方壶胜境
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四宜書屋之東臨池樓宇為方壺勝境上下各五楹南建坊座二其北樓宇為噦鸞殿又北為瓊華樓噦鸞殿東為蕊珠宫宫南船塢後有龍王廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按方壺勝境四十景之一額為皇上御書坊座南額曰芝田日永曰閬苑春深北曰鳯鳴珠樹曰鹿夀靈臺方壺勝境樓宇上額曰宜春殿曰敬勝怠噦鸞殿樓宇上額曰用厥中曰有真賞在瓊華樓額曰潄芳潤及蕊珠宫額皆御書
evidence.summary: East of 四宜書屋 on the water: 方壺勝境, five bays on two floors, with two archways to the south, 噦鸞殿 and 瓊華樓 behind, 蕊珠宫 to the east, a boathouse and a 龍王廟. The note gives each plaque.

evidence.title: 《日下舊聞考》 on 船塢 in 西峯秀色 and 蕊珠宫
evidence.excerpt_zh: 西峯秀色迤東東西船塢各二所 / 噦鸞殿東為蕊珠宫宫南船塢後有龍王廟
evidence.summary: Four boathouses east of 西峰秀色 and one south of 蕊珠宫. YM85 is not 蕊珠宫's dock per the plan note: no text found for it.

evidence.title: Scene 29, 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing
evidence.excerpt_other: On this terrace there were two large buildings and four smaller side buildings, all of two stories and with elevated walks connecting their second stories.
evidence.summary: Upper brick-faced terrace: two large and four smaller two-storey buildings linked at upper level. Lower terrace on the lake: three two-storey buildings. A bridge and two piers to three small terraces with open pavilions, marble balustrades and steps for the barge. Twelve buildings with golden glazed tile. Built 1740 (Tse Li vol. 2 p.33, vol. 20 p.8). Smaller palace to the east, another across the lake north, boathouse.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label: a building stood here, its name unknown.
